title: Actual finite quotient descent with its comparison retained
statement: Assume X,d,phi,hphi,hcompat,M,V,T,hperfect,hmark as in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-stalk-models]. There exists level data L as in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-actual-levels], together with isomorphisms from the explicit realization [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-realization] of L.K to the actual restricted quotient tower of M, intertwining the consecutive arrows through the canonical scalar compositor [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-coherence]. No comparison with the constant model is asserted.

source.place: Tags 09AL and 09B1 (derived etale/pro-etale comparison), 09C6 (actual finite quotient descent) and 06YY (balancing).

proof.text: For each n, use the proved retained-origin construction to choose K_n with its bounds, finite locally constant homology, actual quotient comparison and inhabited Isom stalks.
The lower endpoint of each finite interval shows that K_n is bounded below.
Apply transition descent to these specified origins. It supplies dK_n, sourcewise universal normalization and actual scalar realization isomorphisms satisfying the strict tower equation.

Use the general proved coherence of etale normalization for each dK_n. Package K, bounds, lisse cohomology, stalks, dK and universal normalization as L, and then package actual and its normalized equation as the required descent structure.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C6 via retained marked origins, followed by coordinate transition descent; K3 2026-10-28.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdic_actual_level_descent
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n))
    (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) :
    ∃ L : FinitePerfectAdicActualLevelData X d M V T,
      Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicActualLevelDescent X d M V T L)
